goal: Allow external signer wallets to hold private keys and have the external signer flag toggled
Enables users to combine hot keys and hardware signers in multisig or MuSig2 setups
agreement: Substantive support with no open objections across reviewers
Strong support for unblocking mixed hot key and external signer multisig setups (PraneethGunas)
Verified by testing mock signers and Qt and CLI workflows (adyshimony, naiyoma, jeanpablojp)

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because it enables hybrid wallet setups combining hot keys and external hardware signers
Unblocks multisig and MuSig2 workflows previously prevented by forced watch-only constraints
